item.title: How a Read Replica Almost Took Down Its Primary Database
item.description: Six lessons from running databases at scale at Photoroom, covering backfills, PostgreSQL locks, schema changes, connection pools, query plans, and automated safeguards. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Moving 74GB Off RDS with a Week-Long Rollback Window
item.description: How Prisma migrated 83 tables and 74 GB from Amazon RDS to Prisma Postgres with zero downtime using logical replication, and kept a rollback open for a week. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Postgres 19 is Late, and It's AI's Fault
item.description: LLMs are finding bugs faster than committers can fix them (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: her path from Oracle DBA to Postgres contributor

item.title: Your App Doesn't Need Postgres Superuser
item.description: A PostgreSQL superuser is effectively shell access on the host. Here is what it really grants, why your app does not need it, and how to scope any tool or agent down. (1 source: postgresweekly)
